description: Crosswalk zone WAF custom rules (http_request_firewall_custom phase). Applies once the Worker is routed on a custom domain; workers.dev has no zone WAF.

rules.description: API accepts GET, POST and DELETE only
Drop scanner probes for files this app never serves
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path contains "/.env" or http.request.uri.path contains "/.git" or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".php") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/actuator"))

rules.description: Cross-site writes: state-changing API calls must come from this origin
rules.expression: (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") and http.request.method in {"POST" "DELETE"} and len(http.request.headers["origin"]) > 0 and not any(http.request.headers["origin"][*] eq "https://${HOSTNAME}"))

rules.description: Uploads larger than the API accepts
rules.expression: (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/controls/") and http.request.method eq "POST" and http.request.body.size gt 3145728)
